component.name: Walmart Store Finder
component.summary: Nationwide Walmart store search and a saved distribution-center list

description.p: Desktop version of Walmart Store Finder. Search the bundled United States store list by store number, city, state, or ZIP, save a result, and keep your own stores and distribution centers. Saved entries stay on this computer. Store locations are from OpenStreetMap contributors under the Open Database License. The starter distribution-center list also uses the ABFBA 2026 public warehouse list. Phone numbers and street addresses that were not in those sources are left blank.
Nationwide offline search, a starter distribution-center list, and one-tap save. Lists saved in version 1.1.8 stay in place.
